discussion_comments.comment_body:
The `@linkcode` is functional, but I would prefer to keep the same style as the other deprecation messages.

```suggestion
/** @deprecated since v8, instead use InvalidArgumentError */
```
When is declaring `_args` as deprecated better than leaving it undeclared, and hence an error to use?
When coding in JavaScript and `checkJs` is not turned on in the TSConfig.
Feels slightly backwards, but it is typical to add warnings about deprecated things before removing them. Ok.

Use same style as other deprecated messages
```suggestion
  /** @deprecated since v11, instead use `.registeredArguments` */
```
I actually thought about specifying the version, but decided against it because the property had never been supported officially.
